item.title: Secretion
item.description:
I begin by sitting on the porch, cross legged. I place my hands together, but I cant find my heart. Rain clouds the natural sounds of the night and I am floudering.

After some time, my vision begins to blur. The shape of trees turn to suggestion. One cricket close to my right chirps steadily outside the downpour. I begin to count with each chirp. Twenty-two is the number I reach before I lose myself. A woman screaming in the dark. I run after her - my bare feet sloshing in the rain. Then I surface to a boom. I call the “secretion” quietly. As thunder passes, the cricket returns.

item.title: First Post
item.description:
Introduction

Hi friend(s). If youre reading this, you found my website and this is its first post! Congratulations. I have had many, many iterations of a personal website of mine (and this is likely the first youve ever seen) BUT I believe this one should stick.

What to expect

Here you will find my haiku poetry, daily komorebi photography, and blog posts about general musings and thoughts. There will be some haibun, and prose as well but I dont want to promise too much yet. I find my main problems with websites is biting off so much more than I can chew. So for now: haiku / komorebi / blog.
